name: How long does a typical window frame repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical window frame repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a window frame repair depends on the complexity and extent of the damage. Simple repairs, such as fixing minor cracks or replacing small sections of wood rot, might be completed in a few hours. More involved repairs, like extensive rot removal or structural reinforcement, could take a full day or multiple days per window. We provide an estimated timeline during our initial assessment to help you plan accordingly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on damage complexity. Simple fixes may take hours; extensive repairs could take a full day or more per window. We provide estimated timelines.
